# webtables/toolchain

> How to build and run: `wat2wasm`, then a WASI runtime.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/toolchain.pkg)

The module is written to `prog.wat` and converted with `wat2wasm` from
[wabt](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt). The result is a WebAssembly
module (preview 1 WASI), not a native executable, so `packenger run` uses
the `emit run` section: `wasmtime` with the filesystem root as the first
preopened directory (fd 3) and the working directory as the second
(fd 4), which is where [syscall](syscall.md) looks for paths.

Any WASI runtime can run the output, e.g. `wasmtime prog.wasm` or
Node's `node:wasi`; in a browser, with a WASI shim.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit file`

```nasm
prog.wat
```

### `emit`

```nasm
wat2wasm prog.wat -o {out}
```

### `emit run`

```nasm
wasmtime run --dir=/ --dir=. {out}
```
